children: Overview
Industrial equipment maker's Q3 revenue grew 44% yr/yr, driven by SPX FLOW acquisition and organic growth
Q3 adjusted EPS rose and beat analyst expectations
Company raised full-year guidance for all key metrics
Outlook
ITT raises 2026 organic revenue growth outlook to 7%-9%, total revenue growth to 41%-43%
ITT raises 2026 EPS guidance to $4.65-$4.73, adjusted EPS to $8.54-$8.62
Company expects 2026 free cash flow of $600 mln-$620 mln, margin near 11%
Result Drivers
SPX FLOW ACQUISITION - Co said revenue and order growth were largely driven by the SPX FLOW acquisition
AEROSPACE AND DEFENSE - Organic growth attributed to demand for aerospace and defense connectors and pump projects
PRICING AND PRODUCTIVITY - Higher volume, pricing actions and productivity improvements offset higher costs
